subset_spec.subject: sub-001
notes: OpenNeuro ds003059 v1.0.0 is a derivative dataset.
run-01 and run-03 are resting-state runs; run-02 is music and excluded from the MVP subset.
The default MVP path is summary-first, but these include paths define the smallest useful download slice.

download_command: uvx openneuro-py@latest download --dataset=ds003059 --tag=1.0.0 --target-dir data\ds003059_mvp --include dataset_description.json --include README --include CHANGES --include sub-001/ses-LSD/func/sub-001_ses-LSD_task-rest_bold.json --include sub-001/ses-LSD/func/sub-001_ses-LSD_task-rest_run-01_bold.nii.gz --include sub-001/ses-LSD/func/sub-001_ses-LSD_task-rest_run-03_bold.nii.gz --include sub-001/ses-PLCB/func/sub-001_ses-PLCB_task-rest_bold.json --include sub-001/ses-PLCB/func/sub-001_ses-PLCB_task-rest_run-01_bold.nii.gz --include sub-001/ses-PLCB/func/sub-001_ses-PLCB_task-rest_run-03_bold.nii.gz --include sub-001/anat/sub-001_T1w.nii.gz
notes: This is a convenience bootstrap helper for a minimal ds003059 subset.
It is not the canonical provenance record for Stage 2 empirical fitting.
